objective: Snapshot all previously uncommitted changes, then ablate their mechanisms and remove unnecessary design without losing behavior.

scope.snapshot_message: feat: improve incremental analysis and validate editor behavior
scope.note: The snapshot was committed before any ablation. Historical baseline reports remain historical; this report covers the new experiments.

accepted_simplifications.area: SSR single-tree match and edit pipeline
removed: Duplicate Match FileRange; the matched CST node already owns its range and each search scans one file.
FileId plumbing and cross-file sorting from the per-tree search/deduplication helpers.
Second deduplication Vec, temporary (FileRange, String) edit Vec, and the second reverse-position sort.
retained: Semantic binding identity, invocation-scope resolution, placeholder constraints.
Selection filtering before outermost deduplication; comment preservation; reverse edit order.
The IDE still owns multi-file edits, include-instance ambiguity checks and parse validation.
evidence: Final SSR protocol regressions in both workspace test modes.
Three alternating release pairs: 500 edits with identical range/text digest in every run.
accepted_simplifications.timing_interpretation: Paired p50 changes -1.47%, +1.42%, +1.64%; no speedup claimed. Retained for smaller state and fewer intermediate allocations.

removed: Duplicate traversal and attribute exclusion logic for name vs name span.
Three repeated name-span queries in callable lowering, replaced with one local result.
invariants: Both public APIs select the same token.
Preserve early None for a present NAME node without an identifier.
Preserve quoted names, operator names, attribute and termination-measure exclusions.
evidence: Default and no-SMT workspace tests, including attributed function/type diagnostics and navigation.

removed: Two ArcTopLevelEnv clones at the environment query boundary.
accepted_simplifications.replacement: Borrow the existing Salsa query result for the duration of semantic compatibility/field lookup.
evidence: All semantic completion and incomplete-code completion tests in final workspace gates.

negative_control_decisions.without-speculative-syntax: Retain: removing the temporary marker loses expected types for unfinished arguments and record initializers.
negative_control_decisions.without-type-compatibility: Retain semantic subtype/alias/generic constraint matching: replacing it with equality fails seven completion regressions.
negative_control_decisions.without-trivia-fingerprint: Retain: a raw-text fingerprint re-infers a callable after an internal comment edit.
negative_control_decisions.without-token-relocation: Retain: base-offset-only relocation leaves related constraint locations stale after internal trivia edits.
negative_control_decisions.without-divisibility-rule: Retain: the focused no-SMT proof no longer discharges the bounded power-of-two divisibility goal.
negative_control_decisions.without-existential-scope: Retain: leaking bound existential names into implicit quantification loses both constructor argument-order rejections.
negative_control_decisions.without-pattern-provenance: Retain: discarding alias-to-written-argument provenance highlights the wrong type-pattern range.

performance_ablations.method: Release builds, CPU 0, three rounds, alternating pair order; no concurrent builds or test jobs during the accepted measurements.

parse_seed.decision: Retain weak previous-tree seed. Full parsing costs 2.27–2.36x cached p50 on this 23,890-byte/400-function fixture; every tree, token stream and error list is equal.

compact_fixities.decision: Retain compact projection. Replacing it with full ItemTree lowering raises p50 input update time from 5.94–5.99 ms to 8.18–8.70 ms. Operator contexts are equal after every edit.
compact_fixities.fixture_note: The initial fixture only installed workspace membership once, so subsequent edits bypassed update_workspace_fixities. Those initial timings are excluded. The corrected fixture installs membership on every edit and times the complete apply_change path.

direct_speculative_parse.decision: Reject replacing incremental speculative parsing with a direct full syntax parse. Trees agree, but the 400-function identifier case is 25–27% slower despite improvements for small files and incomplete calls. No adaptive thresholds or extra production path added.

other_scope_decisions.decision: Keep lexer-error propagation, fixity checks, validation refresh and UTF-8 edit/undo fallback; exercised by the retained differential parser tests.

Keep kind-aware constructor arity checking, vector-access dependencies and shared named-call inference. These support the configured-project mutation regressions; removal is not a simplification that preserves behavior.
Keep priority separate from cancellation retry. Both policies have real callers; the complete policy-combination and protocol cancellation tests remain in the final gates.

Keep latency tracing, Salsa execution callbacks, editor probes and mutation/diagnostic reports. These are the measurement and regression mechanisms used to distinguish useful optimizations from redundant ones.
Preserve the prior removal of unsupported APIs and formatter duplicate assembly already present in the snapshot; this round removes remaining redundant SSR per-file state.

verification.clippy_note: Command succeeds with 40 diagnostic warnings, the same count recorded in the pre-ablation quality report; this task does not clear pre-existing warnings.

limits: Local microbenchmarks do not establish end-to-end LSP speedup or Zed SSH experience.
This is an ablation and behavior-preserving simplification audit, not a fresh upstream corpus/conformance or solver-unknown campaign.
No claim that every abstraction is removable or that every changed line needs its own ablation; retained semantic guards have negative-control or existing regression evidence.

The initial speculative probe build failed due to placing the SSR example in a package without an ide-ssr dependency; it was moved to the ide package. Temporary examples were removed after measurements.
Performance samples collected alongside the initial control test/build are excluded; accepted samples use the isolated CPU-pinned runs.

evidence: Seven runtime failing negative controls, restored before final gates.
Three-round cache/fixity/speculative-parse comparisons and paired SSR equivalence measurements.
Scope decisions record retained semantic, parser, scheduler, harness and prior simplification changes.
